purpose: Machine-readable catalog of Gmail connector commands used by the manager agent.
source_of_truth: Connected Gmail app connector, discovered through tool_search on 2026-05-05.

read_only_tools.use_for: Label names, label IDs, inbox/unread/draft counts, and user-label discovery.
notes: Use this before label-specific searches or label mutations.
For user labels, capture the Gmail label ID because search tags expect IDs.

read_only_tools.use_for: Primary Gmail search with summaries, labels, attachment metadata, display URLs, and pagination.
notes: Preferred first search tool when content summaries are useful.
Gmail query syntax and tags filtering both worked.

read_only_tools.use_for: Message-ID retrieval for later batch reads or explicit write operations.
notes: Use only when IDs are needed; list_labels is better for counts.

read_only_tools.use_for: Read multiple exact messages by Gmail message ID.
notes: Can return large newsletter bodies and tracking-heavy HTML/text.
Summarize; do not store or quote raw private bodies in manager memory.

read_only_tools.use_for: Read one complete conversation before drafting, replying, forwarding, tasking, or making a decision.
notes: Use id_type=message when starting from a search result message ID.

read_only_tools.use_for: Read several conversations by message or thread IDs for triage and comparison.
notes: One Russian supplier body decoded as mojibake while subject and snippet remained readable.
When body decoding is suspicious, rely on snippet, metadata, attachment files, or ask to inspect in Gmail.

read_only_tools.use_for: Find existing drafts without changing or sending them.
notes: Good for draft review selection; do not update or send without explicit owner approval.

read_only_tools.use_for: Fetch an attachment by message ID plus attachment ID or filename.
notes: Returned file metadata and file_uri for a PDF attachment.
Parsed PDF text can be garbled when source encoding or embedded text is poor; use the PDF/document quality workflow for final extraction or formatting decisions.
Drafts with attachments are not editable through this action.

safe_default_workflows: list labels for counts and label IDs
search summaries with narrow Gmail query syntax
read the exact message or thread before summarizing or drafting
read attachments only when the owner asks or the task requires the attachment
extract only durable decisions, deadlines, tasks, approvals, and operating notes into manager memory
do not store full email bodies, raw threads, private attachments, or one-off newsletters in manager memory
known_connector_limits: some Russian or supplier message bodies may decode as mojibake
newsletter and marketing messages can return very large, noisy bodies
has:attachment may surface inline images or calendar-style noise, so inspect attachment metadata before reading files
PDF attachment parsed text may be garbled; use PDF/document rendering or local extraction for final document work
